title: Up The Keys Tours

services.name: Dolphin Research Center Day Tour
services.desc: A 7-hour Florida Keys wildlife day trip from Key West-dolphins, Key deer, Bahia Honda, Blue Hole, lunch, admission, and pickup included. This tour will take you half-way up the Florida Keys and over the iconic 7-Mile Bridge. On your Up The Keys dolphin encounter tour, we begin our excursion with a stop at the Key Deer Refuge for a unique encounter with the friendly Key Deer! Afterward, your guide will bring you to the Blue Hole, where you will learn about its unique features and spend some time appreciating the local wildlife.
